tool.name: CrewAI
tool.summary: Production-ready framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents that collaborate seamlessly to solve complex tasks.
tool.architecture: Role-based agent abstraction with task delegation and hierarchical memory.
tool.usage:
from crewai import Agent, Task, Crew
researcher = Agent(role='Researcher', goal='Investigate tech trends', memory=True)
task = Task(description='Summarize 2025 AI models', expected_output='Bullet summary', agent=researcher)
crew = Crew(agents=[researcher], tasks=[task])
crew.kickoff()
tool.benchmarks: Over 25,000 GitHub stars; widely used in enterprise workflow automation.
tool.limitations: Iterative agent loops can quickly trigger API rate limits without rate limiting.
